entities.text: Shaloo Trivedi vs. Vipin Trivedi & ors)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The opposite party no.2 (wife of Vipin Kumar Trivedi) filed a complaint alleging therein that her marriage was solemnized with Vipin Kumar Trivedi on 26.11.2011.

It is alleged that her husband,
father-in-law and mother-in-law demands additional dowry and harassed & torture the complainant.
The complainant examined herself U/s 200 Cr.P.C. and two witnesses U/s 202 Cr.P.C.
The learned Magistrate by the impugned order has summoned the revisionist-accused and co-accused Vipin Trivedi to face trial for the offence U/s 498A, 323, 506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act.

The learned Magistrate in the impugned order has narrated the entire facts and analyzed all the material and evidence on record and on its basis has come to the conclusion that a prima-facie case Rama Nath Trivedi vs State Of U.P. And Another on 17 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/25676913/
1 is made out against the accused Vipin Trivedi and Ram Nath Trivedi and has summoned them.

entities.text: Rama Nath Trivedi vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The allegations of the complaint discloses a cognizable offence showing the complicity of the revisionist-accused in the incident.
The averments of the complaint is supported with oral testimony of the complainant who is also a victim and two of her witnesses produced U/s 202 Cr.P.C.
It is settled law that at this stage only prima-facie case is to be seen.
The learned Magistrate has passed a detailed and reasoned order.
There is no illegality in the impugned order.
Accordingly, the revision is devoid of merits and is hereby dismissed.
